recipes.name: Steak, Mushroom, and Asparagus Bowl
ingredients: Flank, skirt, or flatiron steak, 350 g
instructions: Combine all the sweet & spicy sauce ingredients together until homogenous. Set aside.

To cook, heat a wok (or a large fry pan) over high heat. Add a drizzle of neutral oil and the garlic and bloom for 20 seconds. Add the mushrooms and asparagus with a pinch of salt and stir fry for a couple of minutes. Set aside, and wipe the wok clean.

Heat the wok until smoking again and add oil to the pan. Add steak cubes and let them sear on one side for a couple of minutes to brown the exterior. Toss and cook the other sides of the steak, then add the stir-fry sauce. Cook for another minute or so to let the sauce reduce and glaze the steak.

Add a serving of rice to a bowl, half of the vegetables, a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds, and the steak. Add any additional toppings you may enjoy: scallions, mayo, stir fry sauce, and pickled ginger. Enjoy!
